about: Serving rules for Dark Breezy (DARKBREEZY.md §5), in srvcfg's format (srvcfg/docs/server.md), for hosting on a server of our own (Hetzner, later). GitHub Pages ignores this file: there the CSP is the <meta> in index.html. Dark Breezy uses hash routes (#/place/...), so no SPA fallback is needed; 404.html sends place paths that lost their # back into the app. This file stays outside the public web root.

patterns.paths: Paths are relative to the web root, with / between folders and no leading /.
patterns.noSlash: A pattern without / matches a file name in any folder.
patterns.withSlash: A pattern with / matches the whole path.

etag.note: Send ETags and answer If-None-Match with 304. Content hashes are preferred; mtime-size requires preserving build file times.

publish.note: Upload every other file first, including the new file list. Replace deployment.json atomically, then purge it from any CDN.

always.note: no-referrer: the weather services don't need to know which page you were on. geolocation=(self): "Use my location" (only when tapped).

rules.note: Self-hosted static data with the version in its name (jma-areas-v1.json): a change is a new file.

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://tilecache.rainviewer.com https://gibs.earthdata.nasa.gov; connect-src 'self' https://api.open-meteo.com https://air-quality-api.open-meteo.com https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com https://marine-api.open-meteo.com https://api.weather.gov https://api.weather.gc.ca https://api.brightsky.dev https://www.jma.go.jp https://mreversegeocoder.gsi.go.jp https://data.weather.gov.hk https://www.gdacs.org https://services.swpc.noaa.gov https://api.rainviewer.com https://tilecache.rainviewer.com https://photon.komoot.io https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org; font-src 'self'; manifest-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'; frame-src blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'

rules.note: The same policy as the <meta> in index.html, plus frame-ancestors, which works only as a header. connect-src and img-src name each weather service and tile host (DARKBREEZY.md §5): adding a source means adding it here and in index.html. frame-src blob: is for the cache buster's hidden page (cache-bust.js refreshMemory), which reloads Firefox's in-memory copies of stylesheets and images.
